title: High school SETI@home club crunching Arecibo data
summary: Martin Shkreli tells of High school SETI@home club crunching Arecibo data, about late 1990s-2000s at Arecibo radio telescope data; Shkreli's high school, US, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Arecibo radio telescope data; Shkreli's high school, US

tellings.quote: formed our high school club for seti at home and it was like three people and we all contributed our screen saver compute time

plain: Martin Shkreli, a former drug-industry businessman, says that as a teenager in the late 1990s he and two friends formed a high school club for SETI@home, a project that let ordinary home computers help search for radio signals from alien civilisations. He says they let their computers crunch data from the giant Arecibo radio telescope whenever the screen saver was on. He tells it to show his interest in the search for alien life goes back a long way.
